sourceText:
Different Pizza
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 11:33pm

Ingredients




1 pound Ground beef browned with
cup Chopped onion
2 teaspoons Worcestershire
teaspoon Marjoram
teaspoon Oregano
teaspoon Sage
teaspoon Pepper
1 can Cream of mushroom soup
2 cups Flour
teaspoon Salt
2 teaspoons Baking powder
cup Crisco
1 cup Milk
2 cups Shredded mozzarella

Preparation

1 Drain beef and onion; stir in Worcestershire, seasonings and soup. Blend well; set aside. 2 Combine flour, salt anda baking powder; cut in shortening. Add milk and stir until mixture resembles a soft biscuit dough. Pat into a greased 15X10X1" baking pan. Spread with beef. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 25-30 minutes at 400F.
